title: Smallest Integer Divisible by K
description: Find the length of the smallest number consisting only of digit 1 divisible by k.
pseudocode:
1. length = 1, remainder = 0
2. for length from 1 to k:
3.   remainder = (remainder * 10 + 1) % k
4.   if remainder == 0: return length
5. return -1

steps.note: Initialize length to 1 and remainder to 0.
